{{Quote|It's called bilerat stew, Zayne&mdash;it's one of the few staples we've got plenty of. Smells awful, but the thermochurns keep it good for months.|[[Koblus Sornell|Ko Sornell]] to [[Zayne Carrick]]|<ref name="War2">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 2|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 2]]</ref>}}
A '''thermochurn''' was a utensil used by [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] at war for keeping [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] good for months.

[[Koblus Sornell|Ko Sornell]] used one to keep [[bile-rat stew]] warm for her family during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].
